Messages.Author: shang
Messages.Body:
1. If Talaq is in combat and strikes with Burst of Sunlight (1 or 2R agg to
all VAMPIRES in combat), does Talaq also receive damage from Burst?

2. If Talaq is in combat and the opposing minion strikes with Burst of
Sunlight, does Talaq receive damage from Burst?

3. If Talaq is in a forest and a tree falls on him and crushes him, does
Talaq make a sound?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
shang wrote:
> 1. If Talaq is in combat and strikes with Burst of Sunlight (1 or 2R agg to
> all VAMPIRES in combat), does Talaq also receive damage from Burst?

No. Burst damages only vampires, and Talaq is not a vampire.

> 2. If Talaq is in combat and the opposing minion strikes with Burst of
> Sunlight, does Talaq receive damage from Burst?

No.

> 3. If Talaq is in a forest and a tree falls on him and crushes him, does
> Talaq make a sound?

Yes. He'll wimper: "Ooi!" :-)
